objective: FARO STUDIO PLAYBOOK 06 — Ideation: scan trends, brainstorm 5+ concepts from a market gap, and score them. Read-only. Produces a ranked shortlist for the Director to fund.

steps.task: Scan for trends relevant to the product brief named in the kickoff message. Read products/<slug>/BRIEF.md and any products/ideas/ notes first. If web research tools are not granted, work from local evidence only and mark items needing verification. Produce: trend table (name, source/date, platform, confidence, product implication), opportunity gaps ranked by ease-of-exploitation × market-impact, and 'why now' analysis for each.

Using trend-scan evidence and the product brief, generate 5+ distinct product concepts. Each concept must: have a unique angle (not a clone), be implementable on the studio stack (offline-first PWA, zero backend, on-device only), and address a real user frustration from the evidence. Return: concept name, one-line pitch, target user fantasy, core mechanic/interaction, emotional arc, visual mood, 'why now', estimated complexity. Rank by novelty × feasibility × emotional impact.

Review every concept from the ideate lane from a game-design perspective. For concepts that include game mechanics or gamification elements, evaluate: core loop viability, session length targets, retention hooks, difficulty curve plausibility, and economy feasibility (on-device only, no server). For non-game concepts, simply confirm they are not games and return 'N/A — non-game concept'. Return per-concept verdict: GAME-VIABLE / GAME-REQUIRES-WORK / NOT-A-GAME, with specific design notes for game-viable concepts.

Score every concept from the ideate lane 1-5 across: Novelty, Feasibility, Market Size, Differentiation, Store-Risk, Effort. Incorporate game-design-check verdicts (game-viable concepts get a feasibility boost; game-requires-work concepts flag design risk). Produce a weighted composite score. Identify kill criteria: any concept requiring a backend, violating store policies, or cloning existing products gets NO-GO with the specific reason. Return: scoring matrix, top 3 recommendations with rationale, kill list with reasons, risk register for recommended concepts.

Reduce all lanes into the Director's ideation memo: ranked concept list (5+ concepts with scores), top 3 recommendations each with 'why fund this' and 'what to watch', kill list with reasons, and the exact next playbook to run for each funded concept (graphs/07-innovation-sprint.json for deep-dive, or graphs/01-discovery.json to go straight to full Discovery). Always respond in English.
